description: Evidence Request rules (Phase 4). Knowledge Search is a shared Evidence Provider, not a fixed workflow step. Query text is TEMPLATE-GENERATED per (domain, purpose) so no caller can inject free-text and no query is invented.

domain_query_template.life: 定期寿险 保障期限 保额 家庭责任
domain_query_template.medical: 百万医疗险 保障范围 免赔额 社保目录外
domain_query_template.critical_illness: 重疾险 确诊给付 保额 收入补偿
domain_query_template.accident: 意外险 伤残分级 意外医疗
domain_query_template.savings: 年金险 储蓄 现金流 确定给付
domain_query_template.general: 保险 保障 责任

notes.specificity: Query specificity comes from (domain, purpose), not from caller free-text. This keeps retrieval deterministic and prevents query injection.
notes.traceability: The requesting artifact is recorded in related_artifact_ids (gap_id / solution_id), never by stuffing its text into the query.
